Name: MH Tool Pouch Extended
Author: mahsouto
Description:
[size=6][b][center]MH Tool Pouch Extended[/center][/b][/size]
[size=5][b][center]What is MH Tool Pouch Extended?[/center][/b][/size]
MH Tool Pouch Extended is an enhanced version of the beloved Tool Pouch mod that revolutionizes how you manage your tools in Stardew Valley. No longer will you be limited by inventory space or forced to carry all your tools at once!

[size=5][b][center]Key Features[/center][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Unified Storage System[/b] - One pouch, consistent inventory across all access methods
[*][b]Smart Chest Detection[/b] - Access your pouch even when stored in chests anywhere in the world
[*][b]Universal Access[/b] - Works with chests in your farm, house, buildings, and any location
[*][b]Improved UI[/b] - Repositioned interface elements for better visibility
[*][b]Auto Food Consumption[/b] - Automatically consume food from your pouch when health/energy is low
[*][b]Smart Pouch Unification[/b] - Automatically merges multiple pouches into one unified inventory
[*]AutoSwap Feature - Change your tool inside tool pouch automatic.
[/list]

[size=5][b][center]What's New in Extended Version?[/center][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Chest Storage Support[/b] - Store your pouch in any chest and still access it
[*][b]Enhanced Compatibility[/b] - Works seamlessly with ChestAnywhere and other storage mods
[*][b]Smart UI Button[/b] - Appears only when your pouch is available (inventory or chests)
[/list]

[size=5][b][center]What's New?[/center][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Auto Food Consumption[/b] - Set health/energy thresholds and the mod will automatically consume food from your pouch, starting from the lowest numbered slot
[*][b]Configurable Trash Option[/b] - Choose whether your pouch can be sent to trash or stay protected
[*][b]Performance Optimizations[/b] - Cleaner code architecture and reduced resource usage
[/list]

[size=5][b][center]How It Works[/center][/b][/size]
[size=4][b]1. Get Your Pouch[/b][/size]
- Receive your Tool Pouch as usual in the mail
- Store all your tools inside (capacity configurable 9-30)

[size=4][b]2. Flexible Storage[/b][/size]
- Keep the pouch in your inventory for instant access
- Store it in any chest when you need inventory space
- The mod will find it automatically wherever it is!

[size=4][b]3. Easy Access[/b][/size]
- Press your configured hotkey to open the tool selection wheel
- Click the UI button or Tool Pouch item in your inventory screen
- Right-click tools to quick-deposit them

[size=4][b]4. Auto Food System[/b][/size]
- Configure health/energy thresholds (default: 30% health, 25% energy)
- Food is consumed automatically from the lowest numbered slot first
- Example: Food in slot 8 will be consumed before slot 12

[size=5][b][center]Configuration Options[/center][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Bag Capacity[/b] - Choose how many tools your pouch can hold (9-30)
[*][b]Hotkeys[/b] - Customize keyboard and controller shortcuts (up to 30 individual item shortcuts!)
[*][b]UI Settings[/b] - Toggle backdrop, adjust animations, position UI elements
[*][b]Behavior[/b] - Configure hover selection and tool swapping preferences
[*][b]Advanced Options[/b] - Control trashing permissions and debug logging
[*][b]Auto Food Consumption[/b] - Set health/energy thresholds for automatic food consumption
[/list]

[size=5][b][center]Compatibility[/center][/b][/size]
[b]Fully Compatible:[/b]
[list]
[*]ChestAnywhere
[*]Expanded Storage
[*]Full heigth inventary
[*]Big Backpack until 90 spaces.
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu
[*]All major gameplay mods
[/list]
[b]Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*]This is an enhanced community version of the original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25136]Tool Pouch[/url] (zulu333)
[*]Save games are fully compatible with the original mod
[*]Configuration settings carry over seamlessly
[*]The description has been translated from Spanish.
[/list]
